LanguageData.MB.OffsetXDesc: Shifts the mechanoid bar left or right.
LanguageData.MB.OffsetYDesc: Shifts the mechanoid bar up or down.
LanguageData.MB.BaseScaleDesc: Size of the mechanoid icons (1.0 = default colonist size).
LanguageData.MB.MechsPerRowDesc: Maximum number of mechanoids in a single row before wrapping to a new line.
LanguageData.MB.MaxNumOfRowsDesc: Limit of rows on the bar.
LanguageData.MB.HideBackgroundDesc: Removes the dark background behind the mechanoid bar.
LanguageData.MB.ShowHealthBarDesc: Displays the health bar under the mechanoid icon.
